data_source_chain: สำนักงานคณะกรรมการกฤษฎีกา (ocs-krisdika)

credits.name: Harvard Library Innovation Lab — OLAW & COLD French Law
credits.contribution: Primary architectural inspiration: flat '1 row = 1 article/มาตรา' dataset shape, conservation principle, and Known-Defects transparency practice, proven on French civil law; RAG citation pattern from OLAW.
credits.cite: Cargnelutti & Cushman, 2024 (COLD French Law); repos harvard-lil/cold-french-law, harvard-lil/olaw

credits.name: Légifrance / LEGI (DILA, France)
credits.contribution: Consolidated-versions + codes model (a code as a living consolidated text with a version timeline); inspired Matra's search-first, code-first navigation and the version timeline.
credits.cite: Base LEGI, Direction de l'information légale et administrative (DILA)

credits.name: Akoma Ntoso (OASIS LegalDocML)
credits.contribution: FRBR Work/Expression/Manifestation model (Work=law group, Expression=consolidated version) and hierarchical eId identifiers, grafted as an interop layer; Matra extends with akn:th:positional_insertion because AKN does not natively model Thai positional amendments (external assessment ~10% confidence without extension), keeping Thai positional structure AKN does not model.

credits.name: Open Law Data Thailand (OLDT)
credits.contribution: Upstream open Thai statute corpus and the gov-backed community (Senate / สลค. / กฤษฎีกา / DGA-backed) that Matra's statute text is sourced from and published back to.
credits.cite: Open Law Data Thailand (Hugging Face publisher: open-law-data-thailand; website openlawdatathailand.org; GitHub DGA-Thailand)

credits.name: สำนักงานคณะกรรมการกฤษฎีกา (Office of the Council of State, ocs-krisdika)
credits.contribution: Original authoritative source of the consolidated statute text (reaches Matra via OLDT); per-record reference_url points at the official searchlaw.ocs.go.th page. Source text is never mutated — upstream defects are annotated, not corrected.
credits.cite: สำนักงานคณะกรรมการกฤษฎีกา / Office of the Council of State (ocs-krisdika); searchlaw.ocs.go.th

credits.name: PyThaiNLP — thailaw dataset
credits.contribution: Thai legal corpus tooling and reference point in the Thai legal-NLP ecosystem; credited as prior open work in Thai legal corpora.
credits.licence: CC0-1.0 (public domain per Thai Copyright Act B.E. 2537 s.7)
credits.cite: Phatthiyaphaibun, W. (2024). ThaiLaw: Thai Law Dataset. Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.10701494

credits.name: phoneee/thai-legal-corpus (Hugging Face)
credits.contribution: Extracted and cleaned Supreme Court decisions (ฎีกา) with citation links; used by the sibling case-law lane to join case law to มาตรา via matra_cid (the ฎีกา layer).
credits.cite: phoneee/thai-legal-corpus (Hugging Face); underlying rulings from official deka.supremecourt.or.th (public domain per Thai Copyright Act B.E. 2537 s.7(4))
